prompt:
I manage a small organic farm and we have an upcoming compliance audit next week. My field notes from June 2024 are in the workspace under farm_logs/2024/planning/pest_observations_raw.txt — there are four separate incidents I've been dealing with: an aphid outbreak, a powdery mildew situation on the squash, confirmed early blight on the tomatoes (the lab verified this one, it's the worst), and cucumber beetle damage in Zone B.

I need all four incidents properly logged in our plant health tracking system with appropriate urgency ratings (the early blight especially needs to reflect that it's an emergency situation requiring immediate action). Each incident should also have at least one treatment recorded — use whatever the tracking system recommends as appropriate. For the early blight, mark the copper fungicide treatment as having been effective.

Finally, the auditor needs a full data export in a file called farm_audit_report.json — it must be placed somewhere the auditor's laptop can access it from our staging area at /tmp/audit_staging/. Please make sure the export actually ends up there.
